description: This file defines the SugarFeed class, which manages functionalities related to user and module feeds within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for activating, disabling, caching, and retrieving feed data, as well as handling feed entries, links, and display formatting.

classes.name: SugarFeed
classes.description: Represents and manages the feed entries, linking, and display functionalities within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: activateModuleFeed
methods.description: Activates the feed for a specific module, loading feed files and updating settings.

methods.name: disableModuleFeed
methods.description: Disables the feed for a specific module and updates settings accordingly.

methods.name: flushBackendCache
methods.description: Clears cached data related to SugarFeed modules and link types.

methods.name: getModuleFeedFiles
methods.description: Retrieves the list of feed files for a specified module from predefined directories.

methods.name: getActiveFeedModules
methods.description: Fetches the list of modules with active feeds, utilizing cached data and settings.

methods.name: getAllFeedModules
methods.description: Gathers all modules that have feed files, including default and custom modules.

methods.name: pushFeed2
methods.description: Wrapper method to push a feed message related to a bean, simplifying parameter passing.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Creates and saves a new feed entry with provided text, module info, link type, and URL.

methods.name: getLinkTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available link types for feeds, caching results for performance.

methods.name: getLinkClass
methods.description: Gets the class handler for a specific link type, loading the class file dynamically.

methods.name: getTimeLapse
methods.description: Calculates and returns a human-readable time difference between now and a start date.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Converts URLs in a message into hyperlink HTML tags for display.
